{{recipe}}

This '''watermelon mojito smoothie''' recipe incorporates the flavors of a [[Cookbook:Mojito|mojito]], although it contains no actual [[Cookbook:Alcohol|alcohol]]. [http://www.foodista.com/recipe/ZWG6JH6L/watermelon-mojito-smoothie Originally posted to Foodista] by Peas of Cake. Foodista recipes are released under a [http://www.foodista.com/static/legal CC-BY license].

==Ingredients==
*1.5 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Cube|cubed]] frozen [[Cookbook:Watermelon|watermelon]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] or less of [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]] (optional)
*1 [[Cookbook:Lime|lime]], juiced
*3–4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] water (depending how on thick you want it)
*4–5 [[Cookbook:Mint|mint]] sprigs

==Preparation==
#Blend all ingredients together in a [[Cookbook:Blender|blender]]. Adjust the amount of liquid as desired.
#Garnish with mint if you like.
